answer: Use a storage-anchored identity. Each agent must hold 50 GB of unique shard data, prove it can return a random shard within 60 seconds on audit, and lose its slot after two missed audits. A newcomer starts with one shard and earns a second only after 30 clean audits across 90 days. Forging 10,000 identities needs 500 TB of live storage, about $7,500 a month plus bandwidth, and one missed audit wipes the fake. Like a pearl forming layer by layer, or a glacier moving too slowly to fake, trust grows too slowly for a sudden plume of fake accounts to slip through.
